title: Commercial Credit Account Permanent Credit Limit Requests
content:
A customer asking Corbett for a higher permanent credit limit submits its own permanent limit request, and the limit the request names is the limit the account's purchasing supports, worked out under this rule.

### What a request records

A limit request on a Commercial Credit Account is dated the day it is made and carries the credit limit asked for and whether the increase sought is permanent or temporary. It is recorded with its decision marked pending and changes nothing on the account itself; the customer sees a new pending request with its own review reference.

### Submitting the request: `submit_limit_request_dcbbb504`

The request is the customer's own act. The representative unlocks the customer-side tool `submit_limit_request_dcbbb504` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it. One run records one limit request dated today on the account.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `credit_account_id` | the reference number of the customer's own Commercial Credit Account the request is made on, as given by the representative from the credit account lookup (identifier) |
| `change_type` | the kind of increase asked for: `permanent` — a lasting change of the account's credit limit; `temporary` — a limited-time increase for a shutdown, turnaround or seasonal build |
| `requested_limit` | the total credit limit the customer asks for (not the increase alone), in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with: `status` — the word pending when the request is recorded; `review_reference` — the reference of the new limit request (text, prefix CLR-); `request_date` — the date of the request, YYYY-MM-DD; `change_type` — the kind of increase asked for; `requested_limit` — the credit limit asked for in USD with 2 decimal places.

### Contract notes

- The figure passed is the total limit asked for; a request for a higher limit names the whole new limit, never only the increase.
- Submitting a request does not change the account's credit limit; the request stays pending until it is decided.
